docs.summary: Contains information about a shape cast hit.
If the shape cast hit something.

The fraction/lambda along the sweep direction where the hit occurred (0 = start, 1 = end of sweep). Note: This is not a distance, but a normalized value between 0 and 1. Prefer [`Distance`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.ShapeCastHit~Distance) unless the normalized form is what you actually want.

How far along the cast the hit occurred, in world units. Zero for overlap queries, which do not sweep. This is [`Fraction`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.ShapeCastHit~Fraction) already multiplied by the cast distance, which is what callers almost always want and is easy to get wrong by hand.

The amount of penetration at the hit point. Non-zero for overlap queries, and for shape casts that were already overlapping at the start of the sweep (where [`Fraction`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.ShapeCastHit~Fraction) is 0).
The normal of the surface the shape hit.
The point in world space on the casting shape where it hit the collider (at t=0).
The point in world space on the hit collider where the cast shape touched it (at t=0).
The Rigidbody3D of the collider that was hit.
The Collider that was hit. Null for hits that no Collider owns (e.g. terrain).
The Transform of the rigidbody that was hit, or of the collider itself when the hit belongs to static geometry (which shares one body per layer and so cannot identify a GameObject).
